question: The expression (cos⁶ θ + sin⁶ θ – 1)(tan² θ + cot² θ + 2) + 3 is equal to:
solution:
**Given:**

(cos6 θ + sin6 θ – 1) (tan2 θ + cot2 θ + 2) + 3

**Calculation:**

(cos6 θ + sin6 θ – 1) (tan2 θ + cot2 θ + 2) + 3

Put θ = 45°

(cos6 45° + sin6 45° – 1) (tan2 45° + cot2 45° + 2) + 3

⇒ [(1over{sqrt2})⁶ + (1over{sqrt2})6 - 1] (1² + 1² + 2) + 3

⇒ [1over8 + 1over8 - 1] (1 + 1 + 2) + 3

⇒ [{1+1-8}over8] × 4 + 3

⇒ -3over4 × 4 + 3 = - 3 + 3 = 0

**∴ The expression (cos6 θ + sin6 θ – 1)(tan2 θ + cot2 θ + 2) + 3 is equal to 0.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**(cos6 θ + sin6 θ – 1)(tan2 θ + cot2 θ + 2) + 3

⇒ [(cos2 θ)³ + (sin2θ)3 – 1)](sin2 θ/ cos2 θ+ cos2θ/sin2 θ + 2) + 3

⇒ [{(cos2 θ +sin2θ)(cos4 θ +sin4θ - sin2θ . cos2 θ) – 1)}(sin4 θ + cos4θ + 2 sin2θ . cos2 θ)/sin2θ . cos2 θ] + 3

⇒ [{(1)(cos4 θ +sin4θ - sin2θ.cos2 θ) – 1)}(sin4 θ + cos4θ + 2 sin2θ . cos2 θ)/ sin2θ.cos2 θ] + 3

⇒ [{(1)((cos2 θ)² +(sin2θ)² - sin2θ.cos2 θ) – 1)}((sin4θ)2 + cos2 θ)2 + 2 sin2θ . cos2 θ)/ sin2θ.cos2 θ] + 3

⇒ [{((cos2 θ + sin2θ )2 - 2 sin2θ.cos2 θ - sin2θ.cos2 θ) – 1)}(cos2 θ + sin2θ )2 - 2 sin2θ.cos2 θ + 2 sin2θ.cos2 θ)/ sin2θ.cos2 θ] + 3

⇒ [{((1)2 - 3 sin2θ.cos2 θ – 1)}(1)2 /sin2θ.cos2 θ] + 3

⇒ [(1 - 3 sin2θ.cos2 θ – 1)(1 /sin2θ.cos2 θ)] + 3

⇒ [(- 3sin2θ.cos2 θ)/(sin2θ.cos2 θ)] + 3 = -3 + 3 = 0

**∴ (cos6 θ + sin6 θ – 1)(tan2 θ + cot2 θ + 2) + 3 = 0**
